title: maxChanges=0 should return invalidArguments (RFC 8620 §5.6 SHOULD)
description: Trigger: client sends maxChanges=0 in ChatContact/changes. RFC 8620 §5.6 says 'If maxChanges is 0, the server SHOULD return an invalidArguments error.' Current code silently returns created=[], hasMoreChanges=true, newState=sinceState. This is wrong behavior for a spec-SHOULD: clients that probe maxChanges=0 to detect this error path get no error. No test exercises maxChanges=0 input.
